purpose: Phase 0 teacher gate: is Qwen3-VL a better-than-random Doom controller? Pre-registered before any teacher episode was run (2026-09-18).

protocol.teacher_action: sampled from pi_T (softmax over answer-letter logits), frame_skip 4, sync mode so latency cannot affect score
protocol.teacher_input: last 2 full-res RGB frames (320x180) + scenario briefing + lettered action list
protocol.random_baseline: uniform over the same action set, same number of episodes, same env seeds
protocol.episode_allocation: exactly N episodes started per scenario; in-flight episodes run to completion (no early-finish selection bias)

pass_rule_per_scenario: teacher mean return > random mean return AND one-sided Welch t-test p < 0.05 AND Cohen's d >= 0.5

decision.pass_on_>=2_scenarios: proceed: Qwen action teacher on passing scenarios
decision.pass_on_<2_scenarios: load-bearing decision for the user: (a) larger teacher (4B/8B) on Modal, (b) perception-label teacher, (c) report negative
decision.per_scenario_fail: scenario stays in the suite; ReflexRL there is reported with the teacher's measured (weak) quality
